errors.text: The proposed route replaces the target HPHT treatment at 6 GPa and 1473 K with cold rolling and partial recrystallization at ambient pressure.
It changes the target material from a dual-phase lamellar Al0.7CoCrFeNi eutectic alloy to primarily single-phase FCC CrCoNi- or FeCoCrNi-based alloys.
Its stated boundary excludes alloys containing brittle intermetallic phases, whereas the target problem specifically concerns an FCC/B2 eutectic containing a hard intermetallic phase.

The falsification experiment does not compare high-pressure treatment with an otherwise temperature- and time-matched conventional thermal treatment, so it cannot isolate the pressure-specific effect sought by the target.
